reviews.text: My Polaris pool cleaner broke the other day. One of the wheels broke at the flange. I thought I had to buy a new one. They were way more than I expected. It came with the house, so I didn't know. Anyway, the sales person suggested a replacement part instead. Easy. 4 screws and $20 bucks vs $650. Nice. *I didn't catch the sales persons name, but she was about 5ft 4in and had short hair, almost a Mohawk. Receipt says Sydney. If that's you thanks! If not, Sydney, please pass on this review.
reviews.author: Michael Zittel

reviews.text: Four guys and not a single person said hello or asked what help we needed.   We walked the entire store, which isn’t big…. From tools to chemicals to toys.   Everyone looked at us and not a word.   We went to another store and bought what we needed.   We will not be back.
reviews.author: Jason Rutledge

reviews.text: Just a heads up that even WITH a receipt, I was   asked for my driver's license (?)  to return an item I bought a 1/2 HR before, with the SAME cashier. Was NOT asked for ID when purchasing with a credit card, and it felt totally unnecessary. When I asked about the hassle (I had the receipt AND the credit card) was told it is policy & they had to confirm I was the same person. Felt unnecessary. Leslie's needs to catch up to the 21st century & I won't be going back again. ☹️
reviews.author: Paul Sue

reviews.text: I thought my pool pump died because that’s what the crooks at Poolwerx told me. Poolwerx quoted me $2800 for a new pump. I went into Leslie’s on Forest Lane and they quoted me half the price for the same pump. But, after talking with one of their associates about the problem I was experiencing, he figured it was just an issue with the pool pump capacitor, which is a $46 fix. Sure enough, I replaced the capacitor and the pump started working like new again. He literally saved me $2750. Honesty is really hard to find these days so this is the store I will continue to use.
reviews.author: Michael Schmidt

reviews.text:
Decent place to get everything needed for home pools.   Convenient,   Great hours availability.     It is a little higher priced than mass merchant stores but pay for proximity and convenience -- it's worth it.

Their Pool School was okay and did learn a little more.

Craig,  the store manager,  reminds me of Jim Cramer.   A good thing !   Helpful,  knowledgeable,   and I have thought friendly enough.     Of course,  like most retail stores,  this is not a  "bartering open air market"  so take your coupons and special advertisements in with you when they're offered..   and one should not expect to "barter"  for additional discounts like you're coming in from the backwood roads -- cheap cheap cheap !
reviews.author: D M

reviews.text: Bad customer service. Been shopping here for years. Tried to return a broken pool brush I bought a month ago and they won't return because it's past 14 days. I need my equipment to last longer than that, it was clearly a bad piece of plastic now it's just junk. Will be taking my business to Dolphin Pool Supply from now on.
reviews.author: Holt Barber

reviews.text: I had a really bad shopping experience at this store. The store manager, Craig,  was really mean and rude. He yelled at me when I ask discounts for chlorine and shock. Will never go back there unless Leslie install someone with proper customer service training in place.
reviews.author: Chen Zhang

reviews.text: Nick and his staff do a great job with customer service and Polaris repair. Really appreciate all the help. Keep up the good work!
reviews.author: Josh Holden

Leslie’s is the industry leader in all things pool and spa, So whether you are looking for the best deals on chlorine tablets and other maintenance essentials, or you need to find fun pool floats, we have you covered. Ask any of our pool experts about pool maintenance and the best way to take care of your pool or spa. While you’re in, talk to any of our pool experts and get the best solutions to take care of your pool and/or spa maintenance issues. Let Leslies help you make the best poolside memories. Expert Advice In-Store and Online Resources Price Match Promise If You Find A Lower Price, We Will Match It Free Water Testing Customized Treatment Plans Free In-Store Repair Labor You Only Pay For Parts Free APC Inspection Thousands of Parts In Stock Mobile App Track Water Tests, Rewards, and More At Leslie's, we know pools. But we're more than just pool experts — we're dedicated to helping you get the most out of your pool experience. Whether you're in need of the highest quality pool products always in stock, complimentary in-store AccuBlue® water testing, free in-store labor for pool cleaner repairs, or a range of convenient at-home services from our nationwide service department, Leslie's has you covered. Your local Leslie's is not just a destination for pool maintenance essentials — it's a hub of enjoyment. Explore our collection of fun accessories, including pool toys, vibrant floats, thrilling outdoor games, patio accessories, and more, designed to enhance your poolside lifestyle. And don't forget to ask us about our Price Match Promise — if you find a lower competitor's price, we will match it. No matter what you may need to keep your pool or spa clean, safe, and beautiful, you can always count on Leslie's to help you get the job done right the first time. Frequently Asked Questions What is Leslie's return policy? If you are not satisfied with your purchase, you can return your item(s) within 30 days for a replacement or refund. Products must be unused, in new condition, and in original packaging. You can find more information sabout our policy and exclusions on our Returns & Exchanges page . Do you have a price match policy? Leslie's is proud to offer competitive prices on the highest quality products you need for your pool. If you find a current lower price on an identical, in-stock item from a qualified local or online retailer, we will match the price. Some exclusions apply. You can learn more about this on our policy page for Leslie's Price Match Promise . Does Leslie's offer in-store pickup for online orders With Leslie's, you have the ability to buy the products you need online, in the store, or buy online and pick up in store — whatever is most convenient for you! If you'd like to pick your order up at your local Leslie's, all you need to do is select your preferred store when adding an item to your digital shopping cart. You'll be able to see available inventory at the store(s) closest to your address, so you can select the pickup option that's best for you. After checkout, you'll receive emails with updates about your order status, including a notification when your order is ready for pickup. Why should I sign up for Leslie's Pool Perks? Pool Perks is a loyalty rewards program that offers many great benefits for pool owners. It's FREE to sign up, and you'll automatically start earning points back in Perks rewards on every purchase. You'll also receive exclusive members-only offers and promotions, free shipping for online orders, and lots of other great benefits . What's the difference between AccuBlue® and AccuBlue Home®? If you're familiar with Leslie's in-store water testing experience, you're probably familiar with the power of Leslie's AccuBlue® technology. It's the best way to get comprehensive, precise water test results, and it comes with a customized water treatment plan. With an AccuBlue Home® membership, you can get the same level of water testing accuracy and reliability in the comfort of your own home, with a customized water treatment plan delivered right to your phone. Members receive a state-of-the-art testing device, and the $50 monthly membership fee essentially pays for itself in store credits to purchase the supplies you need. It's the total solution for a clean, safe, and beautiful pool. You can learn more about the program by visiting our page about AccuBlue Home . What kinds of pool equipment can Leslie's repair? Leslie's offers FREE in-store labor on equipment repairs — you only pay for parts. This is perfect for automatic pool cleaners, which are the most frequently repaired pieces of pool equipment. If your robotic, suction side, or pressure side cleaner isn't working as expected, shows wear and tear, or is simply due for a tune-up, just bring it to your local Leslie's for a FREE inspection. If it needs new parts, that's the only thing you'll pay for. We provide the repair labor as a complimentary in-store service. If you're having problems with your pool pump, you can also bring the motor in for a FREE diagnostic test. While we don't repair motors directly, we can help you in finding a replacement capacitor or a new motor, if need be. If you're having trouble with larger and heavier equipment, like your filter, heater, or the pool pump itself, this is where our at-home services come in handy. Stop by your local Leslie's to schedule an appointment with one of our certified service technicians, or you can request an appointment online . You can also learn more about our in-store repair services in this Resource Center article . data.summary: The reviews for Leslie's Pool Supplies (retail stores) appear overwhelmingly authentic.
